# AI Usage Disclaimer (last updated: v0.2.0)

* **Rust/cargo**: Core logic is human-coded. AI assisted with comment paraphrasing, procedural macros implementations, and test generation.

* **JS/npm**: SolidJS implementation is human-coded. Packages for other frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte) are generated by AI based on the SolidJS code.

* **Playgrounds & Book**: Human designed and AI-implemented.

* **Review & Verification**: All AI-implemented tests, examples and code have been human-reviewed.

* **Note**: While AI-assisted portions are reviewed, code is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind.
